model_rule: NEVER hardcode project specifics into the framework — framework (packages/) is generic, projects (examples/) are specific

findings.gap: downloadExampleFromGitHub hardcodes the GitHub org/repo name `myanlabs/converge` in framework CLI code. Per model §3.5, project-specific identifiers (repo owner, repo name) must not leak into packages/. The repo origin should be read from project.yaml or an env var so the CLI works for forks and mirrors without source edits.
findings.evidence: commands-add.ts line 615: `https://api.github.com/repos/myanlabs/converge/contents/examples/${exampleName}/.converge` hardcodes org/repo. Same function repeats the hardcode at line 628 for git clone URL.
findings.correction: Replace the hardcoded org/repo with a configurable base: read `examples.registry.url` from project.yaml (with sensible default), or accept a `--registry` CLI flag. The template `examples/${exampleName}/.converge` is a convention that's OK for the framework to define, but where the examples live (which repo) is project-specific.
findings.test_to_write: tests/cli/examples-registry-config.test.ts — test that setting a custom registry URL overrides the default and is used for download, and that omitting it falls back to a documented default (not a hardcoded org/repo).

findings.gap: The skill path `.converge/skills/${name}/SKILL.md` is constructed via string template in core executor code rather than read from a resolved path registry. While `.converge/skills/` is a defensible framework convention, the exact path construction should happen in the skill resolver (which already exists at skill-resolver.ts), not duplicated inline in the spawn runner.
findings.evidence: spawn-runner.ts line 985: `const skillPath = `.converge/skills/${skills[i]}/SKILL.md`;` — path construction duplicated in executor instead of using the skill-resolver abstraction.
findings.correction: Use the existing skill-resolver module to resolve skill paths instead of string-templating the path in spawn-runner. The resolver already knows about legacy vs framework vs global conventions. Spawn-runner should call `resolveSkillPath(name)` rather than building the path itself.
findings.test_to_write: tests/core/skill-path-resolution.test.ts — test that skill path resolution is centralized in the resolver and that spawn-runner delegates to it rather than constructing paths inline.
